'''Robert Seymour''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Phoenix tournament]] on 10 November 2000 with Tatooine Operatives, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1445">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-11-outer-rim-opens-in-phoenix-11-10-00d1445/ outer-rim-opens-in-phoenix-11-10-00], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 11 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-11-outer-rim-opens-in-phoenix-11-10-00d1445/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
